verified_context: MAI-DxO outperformed individual generalist physicians on final diagnostic accuracy in two controlled text-only simulations. It was not tested in patient care and the gatekeeper can synthesize missing information.
visual_idea: A blank clinical case record unfolds into a sequence of branching inquiry paths beside a separate human profile contour. The branching is an editorial metaphor for iterative requests, not a clinical decision tree or reported model trace.
constraints: Scientific Editorial Abstraction, scientific-1. Standalone 3:2 landscape magazine illustration, crop-safe in central 16:9 and 3:2. White #FFFFFF dominates; ink #424242, teals #51796E/#344F51 structure, pale sage #E8EFEC and mist #D1E0E2 layers, sparing rose #D4A298/caramel #BC8A5F. Three written concepts considered: A a blank clinical record unfolding into sequential branching request paths beside a separate human profile contour; B a shallow field of blank case leaves with one thread advancing through discrete observation apertures; C two separate pathways, one organic human and one structured orchestration layer, approaching the same closed record. Choose A because it makes sequential questioning legible while keeping the physician and simulation distinct. Reject B as too generic and C because convergence could imply equivalence or clinical validation. Recognisable medical anchor is the clinical record and human profile, deliberately simplified. Branches are metaphor, not measured workflow, anatomy, causal mechanism or result. No diagnostic label, correct/incorrect coding, model-vs-human victory symbol, cost claim, patient benefit, real encounter or autonomous-care implication.
